name: Slow Touch
description: Rest a hand on the target's forearm and slow the passing of time in the limb until the swing drags.

name: Lagging Step
description: Slow the moment a foot lands so an opponent's stride arrives a beat late.

name: Held Beat
description: Stretch the instant before a blow lands so the user has time to turn it aside.

name: Quicken Hand
description: Speed the passing of time in the user's own hand for one strike so it arrives sooner.

name: Aging Touch
description: Press a palm to a blade or a bowstring and age it in a breath so that it dulls and weakens.

name: Mending Pace
description: Speed the passing of time inside an ally's bruise so the body's own mending finishes sooner.

name: Breath Tally
description: Count each breath and let the count fix the user's sense of the pace of a fight.

name: Slow Pulse
description: Slow the passing of time round an opponent's heartbeat until the blows weaken.

name: Skipped Beat
description: Move in the gap between two beats of an opponent's guard to close the distance unseen.

name: Next Beat
description: Feel the next beat of an opponent's movement a moment before it happens.

name: Tempo Strike
description: Strike on the exact beat at which an opponent draws breath.

name: Quick Palm
description: Run the palm's time ahead of the body so the strike lands before the guard is set.

name: Fast Hands
description: Quicken the time in both hands for a few breaths so every motion is faster than it looks.

name: Hasten Foot
description: Quicken the time in the lead foot to cover one extra pace in a single step.

name: Rushed Guard
description: Bring a plain guard up a heartbeat sooner than the arm could move it.

name: Hasten Mend
description: Quicken the time in an ally's cut so that the clot forms and the skin knits in a few breaths.

name: Rust Touch
description: Age a metal buckle or blade until rust bites into it and the metal flakes under the next blow.

name: Quick Throw
description: Throw a pebble whose time runs ahead so it arrives faster than the eye can follow.

name: Drift Sense
description: Feel the drift of time in a room and notice a spot where something moved lately.

name: Trace Reading
description: Read the faint trace that a recent movement leaves and learn which way a person went.

name: Slack Moment
description: Stretch a heartbeat in an opponent's mind so they hesitate a moment too long.

name: Wane Strike
description: Strike a bruised limb and age the bruise to a deep stiff ache.

name: Time Cushion
description: Slow the passing of time round the user's torso so blows arrive weakened.

name: Dwell Hold
description: Let an opponent's arm dwell in one moment so it cannot move on from its posture.
